identity_rules: Never reuse active preview recorder or latest preview face callback.
A new private recorder per still request with exactly one submitted image and no camera attachment can bound possible image identity; callback payload itself has no timestamp or request token.
Register before submitting; permit callbacks from only this private instance; retain exactly one request-owned immutable analysis input.
Require both successful still render and valid face callback; callback is asynchronous and may arrive before or after render completion.
Timeout, absent callback, wrong geometry/point count, non-finite values, model initialization error, license initialization error must fail closed.
Do not interpret empty face callback received during initialization as successful analysis of submitted frame.
not_proven: Camera-free nativeStartPlay2 accepts public null-view (-1,-1) dimensions and performs ready transition on the user device.
Face callback is emitted for submitted still on actual device under normal model/license initialization.
Landmark coordinate domain, rotation, mirror, crop and any internal resize map exactly back to submitted image dimensions.
No face callback leak from mutable global state/shared effect configuration between recorder instances.
Completion/teardown joins face worker and avoids use-after-release on timeout.
implementation_decision: No production Detector adapter added: final geometry and lifecycle ownership barriers remain unverified. Explicitly labeled device probe could evaluate this native path; fake latest-preview or guessed coordinate adaptation prohibited.
